BiblicalUsage: Aaron's name reaches the New Testament through the priesthood he began. Luke places John the Baptist's mother among Aaron's daughters, and Hebrews measures every priest against Aaron — called by God, never self-appointed — before showing Christ as the better priest.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Aaron matters because God chose the priest; the priest never chose himself. That is the pattern Hebrews holds up, and the reason Christ's priesthood is better: He was called by God too, but He lives forever to intercede for us.
